senses.gloss: (v. preced.; cmp. גדש) [to heap up, round;] to plait, dress the hair.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:7">Kel. XVI, 7</cite> <he>גּוֹדְלֵי מצנפות</he> capweavers (on a model head, v. <cite ref="A01998"><he>אִמּוּם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:3">Ib. XV, 3</cite> <he>וגוֹדְלוֹת</he> and dress their hair.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:6">Sabb. X, 6</cite> <he>הגּוֹדֶלֶת</he> she who plaits her hair (on the Sabbath). Ib. 94ᵇ bot. <he>גודלת משום אורגת</he> plaiting the hair (is forbidden on the Sabbath) as an act of weaving; ib. 95ᵃ (another opin.) <he>ג׳ … משום בונה</he> as an act of building. Y. ib. VII, 10ᵈ <he>הגודל כלי צורה</he> he who forms raised figures on a vessel.
M. Kat. 11ᵃ ג׳ תנור to build a stove.
